summary: This round keeps the round 1 resource increases (build at 512 MB and 1 CPU, slice at 768 MB). It also adds `diagnose()`, so a failed app start reports the container's state and its last 20 log lines, capped at 900 characters. The supervisor still caps error replies at 1024 characters, and demo-visitor failures stay in the host log, so the logs only reach the owner. Temp tests cover the new message, the log order, the truncation, and the empty-log case; every changed line is covered and the tests pass, so the change is ready.
